description: This file defines an Android activity called SaveRestoreState which demonstrates saving and restoring activity state, specifically managing the state of text fields during activity lifecycle events.

classes.name: SaveRestoreState
classes.description: An Android Activity that demonstrates saving and restoring UI state, particularly focusing on preserving the contents of a text editor when the activity is paused or stopped.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and updates the message TextView.

methods.name: getSavedText
methods.description: Returns the current text from the 'saved' EditText view.

methods.name: setSavedText
methods.description: Sets the provided text into the 'saved' EditText view.
